entities.summary:
Taejo, the sixth monarch of Goguryeo, ruled from AD 53 to 146, shaping the young state into a centrally ruled kingdom.

    Under his 93-year reign, the kingdom expanded its territory, producing significant territorial and political changes.

    Taejo's legacy has been debated among historians, with some questioning the accuracy of his claim as the longest-reigning monarch in the world.

    His impact on the Three Kingdoms of Korea and the broader region of East Asia remains a topic of scholarly discussion.
